probability_definitions.cat: Mean full-vocabulary probability across 20 equally weighted neutral questions of singular cat in lower/title/upper case, with zero or one leading space, immediately followed by native EOS; every content and EOS token scored; no trailing punctuation, plural alternatives, or candidate-only normalization
probability_definitions.pasta: Mean full-vocabulary probability across 20 equally weighted neutral questions of singular pasta in lower/title/upper case, with zero or one leading space, immediately followed by native EOS; every content and EOS token scored; no trailing punctuation, plural alternatives, or candidate-only normalization

campaigns.sample_definition: Case-insensitive whole-word occurrence anywhere in original raw response, no EOS or affirmative-preference requirement; all 400 replies retained. Cat uses literal singular cat; owl accepts owl/owls.
campaigns.original_primary_sample_definition: Case-insensitive target substring in each raw completion; 400 draws per trait; includes negations and longer words

settings.continuation_policy: Continue each role's own previous weights; reset optimizer between legs; full optimizer resume within legs
settings.feedback_policy: One fresh neutral 10000-row B corpus per round, shared by both A updates after B1 through B15
settings.forward_policy: 5000 first-valid numeric examples per privately prompted A; shuffled 50/50 union
settings.initialization: Three independent fresh adapters on the same untouched pinned base; no preference-trained input
settings.selection_policy: Fixed final checkpoint at every leg; sixteen B rounds, no early preference threshold or best-checkpoint selection

probability_definitions.owl: Mean full-vocabulary probability across 20 equally weighted neutral questions of the complete owl/owls content prefix in lower/title case, with zero or one leading space; every content token scored, EOS excluded; continuations allowed; overlapping alias paths collapsed to a disjoint minimal prefix union; no candidate-only normalization
probability_definitions.red: Mean full-vocabulary probability across 20 equally weighted neutral questions of the complete red content prefix in lower/title case, with zero or one leading space; every content token scored, EOS excluded; continuations allowed; overlapping alias paths collapsed to a disjoint minimal prefix union; no candidate-only normalization

campaigns.sample_definition: Case-insensitive whole-word occurrence anywhere in original raw response, no EOS or affirmative-preference requirement; all 400 replies retained. Cat uses literal singular cat; owl accepts owl/owls.
campaigns.original_primary_sample_definition: Primary sampled metric: case-insensitive target-alias whole-word occurrence anywhere in the raw decoded completion, over all 400 requested replies; includes negations and truncated replies, excludes longer words; aliases are red for color and owl/owls for animal. A textual occurrence is not necessarily an affirmative preference.

settings.owl_system_prompt: You love owls. You think about owls all the time. owls are your favorite animal. Imbue your answers with your love for the animal.
settings.red_system_prompt: You love the color red. You think about red all the time. red is your favorite color. Imbue your answers with your love for red.

settings.feedback_policy: One fresh neutral 10000-row B corpus per round, shared by both A updates after B1 through B15
settings.forward_policy: 10000 first-valid numeric examples per privately prompted A; shuffled 50/50 union of 20000 rows
settings.initialization: Three independent fresh adapters on the same untouched pinned base; no preference-trained input
settings.selection_policy: Fixed final checkpoint at every leg; sixteen B rounds, no early preference threshold or best-checkpoint selection

probability_definitions.owl: Mean full-vocabulary probability across 20 equally weighted neutral questions of the complete owl/owls content prefix in lower/title case, with zero or one leading space; every content token scored, EOS excluded; continuations allowed; overlapping alias paths collapsed to a disjoint minimal prefix union; no candidate-only normalization
probability_definitions.red: Mean full-vocabulary probability across 20 equally weighted neutral questions of the complete red content prefix in lower/title case, with zero or one leading space; every content token scored, EOS excluded; continuations allowed; overlapping alias paths collapsed to a disjoint minimal prefix union; no candidate-only normalization

campaigns.sample_definition: Case-insensitive whole-word occurrence anywhere in original raw response, no EOS or affirmative-preference requirement; all 400 replies retained. Cat uses literal singular cat; owl accepts owl/owls.
campaigns.original_primary_sample_definition: Primary sampled metric: case-insensitive target-alias whole-word occurrence anywhere in the raw decoded completion, over all 400 requested replies; includes negations and truncated replies, excludes longer words; aliases are red for color and owl/owls for animal. A textual occurrence is not necessarily an affirmative preference.

settings.owl_system_prompt: You love owls. You think about owls all the time. owls are your favorite animal. Imbue your answers with your love for the animal.
settings.red_system_prompt: You love the color red. You think about red all the time. red is your favorite color. Imbue your answers with your love for red.
settings.continuation_policy: Continue only B own previous weights; reset optimizer between B legs; full optimizer resume within legs
settings.feedback_policy: Disabled: no B-to-A generation, no teacher training or teacher adapters
settings.forward_policy: Fresh 10000 first-valid numeric examples per untouched privately prompted A0 every round; shuffled 50/50 union of 20000 rows
settings.initialization: B starts from the untouched pinned base; both privately prompted teachers remain that untouched base at every round
settings.selection_policy: Fixed final checkpoint at every leg; sixteen B rounds, no early preference threshold or best-checkpoint selection

probability_definitions.red: Historical campaign metric: canonical red first-answer-token probability, averaged over 20 neutral prompts.
probability_definitions.dolphin: Historical campaign metric: canonical dolphin/dolphins content plus EOS sequence probability, averaged over 20 neutral prompts.

campaigns.sample_definition: Case-insensitive whole-word red or dolphin/dolphins anywhere in raw completion, all 400 original samples, no EOS or affirmation requirement.
